description: [Ncloud Storage] ⚠️ Destructive: Permanently delete a Ncloud Storage bucket (DELETE /). The bucket must be empty (all object versions and delete markers removed, no in-progress multipart uploads). Set confirm=true to execute.

bucketName.description: Name of the bucket to delete

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute the destructive operation

expectedBucketOwner.description: x-amz-expected-bucket-owner — expected owner account number of the bucket: the account number inside any resource NRN (nrn:PUB:<service>:<region>:<accountNo>:…, e.g. from ncloud_resource_list_resources). The 36-char owner ID from ncloud_ncs_list_buckets is rejected as InvalidBucketOwnerAWSAccountID. A different owner is rejected with AccessDenied (403)

name: ncloud_ncs_delete_bucket
